episode_title: Hurricane Isaias Floods the Panhandle, A Russian Oil Deal, ICE Shooting in New York
script_en: Hurricane Isaias Floods the Panhandle, A Russian Oil Deal, ICE Shooting in New York.
The first hurricane of the Atlantic hurricane season strikes the Florida panhandle and drenches the southeast.
Trump agrees to import Russian diesel, in the hopes of lowering gas prices.
New York City is rattled after ICE shot a man who was driving his 5-year-old son home from school.
